findings.modeSelection: Creature construction selects mode1 when engine singleton+0x48 nonnull; otherwise mode2 if+0x50 nonnull, elsemode0.
findings.publicRoleCorrelation: Registered IsMultiplayer checks+0x50. Registered IsServer uses both engine+0x48 and+0x50 plus object48+0x648; IsClient negates it.
findings.noSimpleClientServerModeIdentity: mode1 is not synonymous with every IsServer=true result: offline mode0 can also IsServer=true.
findings.consumerDifference: Mode0 uses interval threshold/reset and retained descriptor. Mode1 immediately invokes evaluator with current input in both xmm1 andxmm2 then queues work. Mode2 follows separate path; cannot assume it is same evaluator.

reusedObservation.scope: Guard runs for selected Animal receiver on observed scheduler calls; not direct constructor-time engine-pointer observation.
